limits: Only the two R59 Train/Validation trajectory files were scanned, each once, one sample at a time.
No Test, training, replay, Torch, Matplotlib, or checkpoint load.
Failed trajectories are executed prefixes. Failure masks are archival fields only; no counterfactual replay.
Internal delta excludes the initial 0-to-first-FC boundary; startup count includes that boundary.
SOC bounds 0.2/0.8 verified read-only in src/v3/control.py. Near-edge counts use initial plus recorded post-step SOC states, <=0.21 or >=0.79; they are state counts, not time fractions.
CSV overviews are decimated for visualization; they are not full-resolution control traces. Failure last100 and 64-step zoom remain exact.
First-start time is elapsed time from profile start, not delay measured from the first positive-load row. Initial zero-load intervals may explain part of it.

mean_delta_weighting_explanation: Own scan means are equally weighted per internal control step; the official report weights by actual step duration (including shortened final intervals). The means are close but not identical.

definitions.internal_delta: fc_kw[i] - fc_kw[i-1], i>=1; sample-initial boundary excluded
definitions.starts: 0 to positive FC, including sample-initial assumed previous FC=0
definitions.delayed_first_start: first positive FC occurs after step 1; not a restart
definitions.restart: positive FC start after the sample already had a positive FC period
definitions.direction_reversal: strict sign change between neighboring nonzero-in-both actual successive internal deltas; zero deltas break adjacency
definitions.failure_row: The source failure message uses a zero-based row index; executed transition CSV rows are one-based.
definitions.mask_timing: physical_feasible_actions_kw and policy_candidate_actions_kw describe the current executed step; next_feasible_actions_kw describes the next step. A physical mask at the unexecuted failure point is not stored separately.

interpretations: The dominant repeated control pattern is +10 kW increments interspersed with -30/-60 kW drops. Exact alternating +10/-10 changes are localized to Train017; it is inaccurate to describe all trajectories as +-10 oscillation.

Each of 43 samples starts FC exactly once. Forty first starts are delayed, three start at time zero. No sample restarts FC after a stop. Train037 stops at step1025 of1222 and stays off for the final198 steps.

Train015 has SOC reserve at the start of each examined window, but the high-load tail drains nearly all of it. At step156 FC falls600 to540 and remains540 through162 while archived candidate masks still include600. This supports insufficient advance reserve/late FC output in the observed prefix, not proof that another policy can finish the voyage.

Train017 reserve shrinks over the100/32/8-step windows: start SOC0.338185/0.227990/0.206998 to final0.200196. Its last8 steps alternate FC590/600 against mean load655.49kW. At failure the next archived policy domain is empty.

All four R59 failures are soc_limited, whose archived classification follows an empty absolute physical mask. Exact separate physical masks at unexecuted failure points were not archived; only the empty next policy masks and failure causes are available.
